investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the Anella Olímpica complex's own events-listing page (already proven live for the smaller Sant Jordi Club hall, see research/source-investigations/sant-jordi-club-barcelona-01/) yields real, directly-crawlable /en/{slug} links shared across every hall in the complex. A plain curl GET of an individual event detail page's static HTML directly contains its own hall as a literal JS variable ('address'). No browser/headless step was needed.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the shared listing page and a sampled event detail page directly exposed real, dated, named concert data (Aitana, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Vetusta Morla, Hombres G, Trueno — 5 real records at proof time, all with address literally stating 'Palau Sant Jordi'). No structural/browser escalation was needed.

venue_reference: Palau Sant Jordi (the main indoor arena of the Anella Olímpica complex, Montjuïc, Barcelona)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence — the complex's own official site, and each event page's own literal 'address = "Palau Sant Jordi"' JS variable.

site_classification.platform: Same platform already classified for venue-barcelona-sant-jordi-club (see research/source-investigations/sant-jordi-club-barcelona-01/): static HTML with literal JS variable assignments carrying event facts (not a rendered JSON-LD block).

title.notes: Each event page's own <title> tag, up to its first '|' separator.

start_date.notes: Each event page's own literal 'startDate' JS variable, a plain local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' string with no offset — FLOATING_LOCAL, never upgraded to UTC.

time.notes: Embedded in the same 'startDate' value (see start_date).

end.notes: An 'endDate' JS variable is present on some but not all pages sampled for this complex.

venue_location.notes: Each event page's own literal 'address' JS variable, discriminating this hall ('Palau Sant Jordi') from the other halls sharing the same listing (Sant Jordi Club, Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys) — only records whose address exactly equals 'Palau Sant Jordi' are retained by this source's own collector config.

source_record_id.notes: The event's own permalink slug (the last path segment of its detail-page URL) — a stable, source-native identifier, the same judgement already made for venue-barcelona-sant-jordi-club.

event_url.notes: The event detail page's own URL, directly crawled from the listing page.
